description: This file defines the Account class, a core part of the SuiteCRM system, representing an account entity with its properties, methods, and relationships. It extends the Company class and implements EmailInterface, including fields, relationships, and business logic related to accounts.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Represents an account in SuiteCRM, extending Company and implementing EmailInterface, encapsulating account details, relationships, and business methods.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the account's name as its summary text.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves linked Contact beans associated with this account.

methods.name: clear_account_case_relationship
methods.description: Clears the relationship between the account and a specific case.

methods.name: remove_redundant_http
methods.description: Deprecated; intended to remove redundant 'http://' prefix from website URLs.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields for list views, such as assigned user name.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in related or additional detailed fields, such as parent account name or campaign name.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns an array of data used for list views, including address concatenations.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a WHERE clause for generic search queries based on a search string.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a complex SQL query string for exporting account data, including related joins.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Assigns account details to a notification template.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Generates a query to find email addresses not linked to the account.

methods.name: getProductsServicesPurchasedQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query that retrieves purchased products or services for this account.
